quantization.inputs: f32 (numpy.float32) then widened to f64; all model parameters and qpos
quantization.outputs: f64 raw (primary, matches tests/support/two_reference.rs Reference.values) plus f32 round-to-nearest comparison values (diagnostic)
quantization.gravity_switch: model.opt.gravity = frozen f32 opt_gravity; qvel=0; mj_forward

qfrc_gravcomp_mapping.definition: generalized antigravity force sum_b J_b^T (-body_gravcomp_b * mass_b * gravity)
qfrc_gravcomp_mapping.qfrc_bias_note: mjData.qfrc_bias at qvel=0 is the gravity generalized force without body_gravcomp scaling; qfrc_gravcomp != -qfrc_bias unless every body_gravcomp=1

native_equivalent.note: free/ball joints have no single native Cartesian axis; MuJoCo ignores jnt_axis for ball, so those entries are not the same field
